description: Mountain photographs by Alex Crystal from Patagonia, Japan and Vietnam: three place stories, a short selection and the complete 56-photograph album.
line: A naturalist’s folio: granite, ice and cloud from Patagonia, Japan and Vietnam.
lede: Granite and ice in Patagonia, volcanic ground and alpine valleys in Japan, karst and farmed valleys in Vietnam, and the complete album of 56 photographs.
